architecture: Deterministic scoring of pose-derived wrist speed, arm-path range, action duration and shoulder rotation. No trained weights.
note: Broad pace/spin family estimate only. Fine-grained spin types are not attempted because no licensed bowling model has passed evaluation.
limitations: This is a transparent pose heuristic, not a trained bowling classifier.
It reports pace versus spin only; it never distinguishes off-spin from leg-spin.
It makes no bowling-legality judgement of any kind.
Handedness is inferred from which wrist moves most, which fails when the bowler is partly out of frame.
It refuses to classify when the pose gate fails.

benchmark.note: No labelled, independent bowling test set exists for this heuristic, so no accuracy figure is published.

provenance.training_data: None. Deterministic rules over MediaPipe pose output.
